proposed: Their timelines abandoned. Johnny: killed in the Void. Laura: rescued, now in Wade's world. Blade, Elektra and Gambit: Wade asks the TVA to save them from the Void
Black Bolt of Earth-838: killed by Wanda
Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
Eddie and Venom: pulled into another universe
Venom: dead, sacrificing himself to save Eddie. Eddie: alive

verdicts.why: At the end of Let There Be Carnage a blinding light takes Eddie and Venom out of their world into another, so 'Active in their own worlds' is not true to the end of that title; The Last Dance opens with them back home, so a stage at Let There Be Carnage is needed.
The pilot summary says Tony survives the crash because of the armored battle suit he had already designed and built, so he did not build it after the plane went down.
The listed antagonists are Loki and Ymir, a single ice giant who opens the Casket of Ancient Winters with him; Frost Giants are only mentioned.
Wikipedia's plot says Tony undergoes surgery to remove the shrapnel near his heart; it was never in it.

After Tony's funeral Thor joins the Guardians, and Love and Thunder opens with Thor travelling with the Guardians as their own team before parting ways, so 'The Avengers' alone does not hold through Love and Thunder.
Galactus senses the unborn child's power, offers to spare Earth in exchange for the child and induces labor; Franklin is born on the way back to Earth.

In the 1991 pilot the parents know about the powers (Jim gathers the children to discuss them), the plot is Dr. Mobius's ghost haunting their home rather than crime-fighting, and the powers come from an unseen being who has travelled the universe and passes his on, not a stated dying alien.

verdicts.value: Bucky: none. Yelena: the Red Room, until she is freed from its control. Alexei: Dreykov's agent, then his prisoner until Natasha and Yelena free him
verdicts.why: Alexei is not Red Room: in 1995 he works undercover for Dreykov, then is imprisoned until Natasha and Yelena break him out, so 'none' is wrong for the opening. Yelena is freed from the Red Room's mind control by the synthetic gas and goes into hiding before it falls, so 'until it falls' is wrong for her too.
